fullPassage: When you pluck a guitar string it moves back and forth hundreds of times every second. Naturally, this movement is so fast that you cannot see it — you just see the blurred outline of the moving string. Strings vibrating in this way on their own make hardly any noise because strings are very thin and don't push much air about. But if you attach a string to a big hollow box (like a guitar body), then the vibration is amplified and the note is heard loud and clear. The vibration of the string is passed on to the wooden panels of the guitar body, which vibrate back and forth at the same rate as the string. The vibration of the wood creates more powerful waves in the air pressure, which travel away from the guitar. When the waves reach your eardrums they flex in and out the same number of times a second as the original string.

questions.passage: When you pluck a guitar string it moves back and forth hundreds of times every second. Naturally, this movement is so fast that you cannot see it — you just see the blurred outline of the moving string. Strings vibrating in this way on their own make hardly any noise because strings are very thin and don't push much air about. But if you attach a string to a big hollow box (like a guitar body), then the vibration is amplified and the note is heard loud and clear. The vibration of the string is passed on to the wooden panels of the guitar body, which vibrate back and forth at the same rate as the string. The vibration of the wood creates more powerful waves in the air pressure, which travel away from the guitar. When the waves reach your eardrums they flex in and out the same number of times a second as the original string.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 원문: they flex in and out the same number of times a second as the original string — '원래 줄과 같은' 횟수
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 'it moves back and forth hundreds of times every second'와 일치해요.

✅ ② 여기가 정답(일치하지 않는 것)! 파동이 고막에 닿으면 '원래 줄과 같은 횟수로(the same number of times ~ as the original string)' 떨려요. '더 많은 횟수로'는 정반대라 일치하지 않아요. ←정답

❌ ③ 원문 'The vibration of the wood creates more powerful waves in the air pressure'와 일치해요.

❌ ④ 원문 'strings are very thin and don't push much air about'와 일치해요.
det.tip: the same number of times as the original string = 원래 줄과 '같은' 횟수 (더 많은 것 아님)

ch: 줄을 뜯으면 1초에 수백 번 앞뒤로 움직인다.
파동이 고막에 닿으면 원래 줄보다 더 많은 횟수로 떨린다.
나무의 진동은 공기 압력에 파동을 만들어 낸다.
가는 줄은 공기를 많이 밀어내지 못한다.

det.korean: it moves back and forth hundreds of times every second
det.analysis:
'그것은 ~ 움직인다'가 핵심이라 주어와 동사부터 놓아요: it(그것은) + moves(움직인다). 주어 it이 단수라 동사에 -s를 붙여 moves가 돼요.

'앞뒤로'는 back and forth라는 굳어진 표현이에요: back → and → forth.

'1초에 수백 번'은 hundreds of times(수백 번) + every second(매초): hundreds → of → times → every → second.

순서대로 이으면 it / moves / back / and / forth / hundreds / of / times / every / second (10단어)예요.
